entities.summary: Yevgenia Nikolayevna Alissova-Klobukova was a Soviet botanist known for collecting and identifying at least six species of pteridophytes and spermatophytes with coauthor Vladimir Leontyevich Komarov. The standard author abbreviation Aliss. is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
